title: Value grading over whole sheets requires the deleted rows to be re-inserted at exactly the original position
evidence: The input is missing a 'Total revenue' row on Revenue Build and a 'UFCF' row on the DCF. The breaks show up only as =#REF!/#REF!-1 and ='revenue build'!#ref!. The GT has both rows re-inserted, which shifts every row below down by one (Revenue Build rows 18-44, DCF rows 95-145; 617 cells differ). In values mode a cell-by-cell match is required with modification ratio == 1.0. An agent that repairs the model correctly without inserting rows fails. Examples: putting the total in an empty row, or computing growth inline as SUM(segments)/prior-1 and linking DCF Revenue to the segment sum. These agents fail on hundreds of shifted cells even though the model values are correct. Passing depends on reproducing the exact layout, not on the finance repair.
confirmation: Same layout dependency: answer_position covers whole sheets in values mode, and the GT shifts RB rows 17+ and DCF rows 95+ down by one. A correct repair that does not insert rows at exactly those positions fails hundreds of cells.
fix: Added one sentence to the prompt after the INDEX/MATCH lines: 'Where a row has been deleted, insert it back at its original position so the rows below move down by one.' The key re-inserts the deleted 'Total revenue' row (Revenue Build row 17) and 'Unlevered free cash flow' row (Operating Model + DCF row 95) and grades whole sheets by position, so the layout is now stated instead of guessed.

title: Prompt instruction to use INDEX/MATCH on 'Revenue Build' for historical FY totals contradicts ground truth for 2019–2023 and omits required A17 label
evidence: The prompt instructs: "Look up TEAM values on the Comps + WACC sheet by INDEX/MATCH against the 'TEAM US' row label. Revenue Build pulls historical FY totals from IS Annual the same way, keyed off the year header row." However, in 'gt_08_golden.xlsx', 'Revenue Build'!D17:H17 (2019–2023) use direct cell references (`='IS Annual'!C3` through `='IS Annual'!G3`), and ONLY M17 (2024 annual total) uses `=INDEX('IS Annual'!C3:I3,MATCH("FY 2024",'IS Annual'!C1:I1,0))`. Furthermore, 'Revenue Build'!A17 in the ground truth contains the hardcoded label `'FY 2024 Annual'` (whereas A16/A17 in the input is `None`), which is graded as a modification cell by `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (weight: 1) despite never being mentioned in the prompt or anywhere in the workbook. Additionally, on 'Comps + WACC', the 'TEAM US' INDEX/MATCH formulas (`C29` and `C40`) are already present and unchanged in `Errors_input.xlsx`.
confirmation: GT 'Revenue Build'!A17 = 'FY 2024 Annual', a label that appears nowhere in the prompt or input (column A is empty there) but sits inside the graded range A2:AA44. The INDEX/MATCH vs direct-reference point alone would not matter in values mode.
fix: gt_08_golden.xlsx: cleared 'Revenue Build'!A17 (the label 'FY 2024 Annual', which no prompt line or input cell asks for). The cell is now blank like the input, so it is a regression cell. Edited in the sheet XML only; no other cell changed. The INDEX/MATCH vs direct-link point does not affect values-mode grading.

title: Golden workbook retains an invalid working-capital reference
evidence: The golden workbook's 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 contains '=R847-M83', although R847 is blank. Its own NWC balances are R83=-84.2928522758825 and M83=29.613, so the change should be -113.905852275882, not the expected -29.613. This contradicts the instruction to fix broken references and calculation errors. Correcting only this reference in a copy of the golden workbook and recalculating produces eight verifier mismatches, including downstream UFCF figures. The modification ratio falls to 0.9903, causing the sole weight-1 verifier to award zero.
confirmation: GT 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 = '=R847-M83' (the input's '=R846-M83' typo, shifted), which references a blank cell. Correcting it to R83-M83 changes graded downstream UFCF and DCF values.
fix: files/gt/gt_08_golden.xlsx: 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 '=R847-M83' -> '=R83-M83' (-29.613 -> -113.906); D94, D95, D100, C102 and the valuation outputs recomputed (part of the same key update as F4).

title: Ground truth leaves 15+ genuine model and formula errors unfixed while grading them as unchanged or modified cells, penalizing thorough fixes asked for by the prompt
evidence: The prompt instructs: 'Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references, data validation issues, potential calculation errors, inconsistent formatting or naming conventions, best practice violations, and any other issues that could affect accuracy or maintainability.' However, 'gt_08_golden.xlsx' leaves numerous genuine errors in 'Errors_input.xlsx' unfixed and grades them against the broken values under `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (weight: 1): (1) 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 (2026 Change in NWC, a modification cell via D94/D95) has the typo formula `=R846-M83` in the input (referencing empty row 846 instead of `R83`, 2026 NWC), which shifted to `=R847-M83` in the golden file (cached value `-29.613`), whereas fixing it to `=R83-M83` yields `-113.906` and causes modification cells D94, D95, D100, C102, and all DCF valuation outputs in C107:C145 to fail; (2) 'Operating Model + DCF'!C90 (2025 DCF Tax Rate, flowing into modification cell C91 NOPAT) is `-0.3` (-30%) while D90:H90 are `0.3` (+30%); (3) 'Revenue Build' Bull case Cloud growth rates in S32:U32, X32:AA32 (`0.27, 0.26, 0.25...`) are lower than Base case rates (`0.32, 0.30, 0.30...`); (4) 'Operating Model + DCF' sensitivity tables in G108:K112 and G122:K126 are hardcoded stale numbers that do not match the base-case upside in C118 (`0.5313` vs `0.4380` in H110); (5) 'Cover'!D8:D9 ('Target Price ' and 'Upside') are left blank (`None`) in GT, causing regression errors in units 2 and 3 when the agent linked them to the DCF output; and (6) 'Comps + WACC'!G5 (`17.63` instead of `0.1763`) and C38 (`WACC = C32` ignoring debt weight). Because modification accuracy must be 1.0 (100%) to pass, fixing any of the errors that flow into DCF cash flows guarantees a score of 0.0.
confirmation: The GT keeps 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 '=R847-M83' (blank R847) and C90 tax rate -0.3 against D90 0.3, both feeding graded UFCF/DCF cells. Fixing them, as the 'audit and fix thoroughly' prompt asks, breaks the all-or-nothing match.
fix: files/gt/gt_08_golden.xlsx: 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 '=R847-M83' -> '=R83-M83'; C90 -0.3 -> 0.3; C36:H36 ='IS Annual'!C75:H75 (empty) -> ='CFS'!E4..J4; I62:L62 ='IS Quarters'!E69:H69 (depreciation) -> =-'Key Stats'!G21..J21 (FY2025 quarterly capex, so C93 = 44.85 instead of C92's 33.2); C111 PV of terminal value '=C110/(1+$C$98)^5' -> '^6' (2030 is period 6 in H97, same as its UFCF; C125 and C138 were not named by QA and are left unchanged); 'Comps + WACC'!G5 17.63 -> 0.1763 (other effective tax rates are decimals). 49 cached values recomputed with the verifier's LibreOffice recalc and written at XML level (e.g. C116 276.63 -> 254.25, C143 279.13 -> 256.53). answer_position no longer grades 'Revenue Build'!S32:U32,X32:AA32 (Bull Cloud growth below Base: hardcoded inputs with no single correct value), 'Operating Model + DCF'!G108:K112 and G122:K126 (pasted sensitivity grids, no single correct rebuild), 'Cover'!D8:D9 (blank target price/upside: three valuation methods, no single link) and 'Comps + WACC'!C38 (WACC = cost of equity; the weighting is a modelling choice and C38 feeds no graded cell).

title: Undisclosed structural row-insertion vs. in-place fill ambiguity in 'Revenue Build' and 'Operating Model + DCF' causes 570 of 617 modification cells to fail
evidence: The task prompt states: 'When completing spreadsheet tasks, strictly avoid altering any cells that already contain values unless explicitly instructed. Modify only the cells that are required for the task.' In 'Errors_input.xlsx', two rows were corrupted into blank rows: (1) on 'Revenue Build', row 16 is blank (bordered/styled as a total row) above row 17 ('  % growth (YoY)'), and (2) on 'Operating Model + DCF', row 95 is blank (bolded) above row 96 ('Year'). However, the ground truth ('gt_08_golden.xlsx') was created by inserting a new row in 'Revenue Build' (placing 'Total revenue ' at row 17 and shifting rows 17–43 down to 18–44) and inserting a new row below row 95 in 'Operating Model + DCF' (placing 'Unlevered free cash flow' at row 95, leaving row 96 blank, and shifting rows 96–144 down to 97–145). Because the prompt forbids altering existing cells that already contain values and never specifies whether to fill the existing blank rows in place or insert new rows, all 3 production units filled 'Revenue Build' row 16 in place and kept 'Operating Model + DCF' rows 96+ unshifted (`Year` in B96, `WACC` in B97, `Discount factor` in B98, `Discounted UFCF` in B99). In `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (weight: 1), 570 of the 617 modification cells (353 on 'Revenue Build' rows 17–44 and 217 on 'Operating Model + DCF' rows 95–145) are in the shifted region, causing all 3 units to score 0.0 (modification ratios 0.0827, 0.0729, and 0.0762).
confirmation: The input has a single blank row (Revenue Build row 16, DCF row 95) where rows were deleted. The GT re-inserts new rows ('Total revenue ' at RB row 17, 'Unlevered free cash flow' at DCF row 95 with row 96 left blank), shifting everything below. Whole-sheet positional values grading therefore fails t
